import java.lang.annotation.*;
@Target(ElementType.TYPE_USE) @interface A { int value() default 0; }
@Target(ElementType.TYPE_USE) @interface B {}
class Coverage { int f(Object @A @B ... values) { int n = 0; for (Object value : values) { if (value != null) n++; } return n; } }
